hypothesis_summary: M05 → M06 reinforcement. Algorithm: XGBoost 5-seed + LightGBM 3-seed rank-mean ensemble. Features: 309 daily factors (NonRE) MI top40 + KR FF5 v2 lagged returns (6F: MKT/SMB/HML/WML/RMW/CMA) + regime indicator (BM 12M vol expanding pct, t-1). Walk-forward expanding monthly. Goal: PG2 blended SR realized > 1.4625 (baseline). M05 sub_stab 0.060 → M06 0.3993 강화. Iter11 (STR_1701) FIXED — 본 alpha는 20% slot 보강만.
